The user wants uninstaller strings in English with character limits:
- s1: title of dialog asking whether to uninstall, max 16 characters
- s2: button that performs uninstall, max 8 characters
- s3: button that keeps app, max 8 characters
- s4: status line shown while files are being removed, max 24 characters
- s5: error when uninstall fails because app is still running (tell user what to do), max 64 characters

s1: "Uninstall App?" — count: U-n-i-n-s-t-a-l-l(9) + space(10) + A-p-p(13) + ?(14) = 14 characters. Good.

Actually "Uninstall" alone is 9 chars. "Uninstall App?" = 14. Good.

s2: "Uninstall" = 10 characters. Too long (max 8). Options: "Remove" (6), "Uninstall" too long. "Yes, Remove"? That's 11. "Remove" is 6. Good.

s3: "Cancel" (6) or "Keep" (4) or "Keep It" (7). "Cancel" = 6. Good.

s4: "Removing files..." = R-e-m-o-v-i-n-g(8) + space(9) + f-i-l-e-s(14) + .(15) + .(16) + .(17) = 17 characters. Good. Max 24.
